items.name: KAV-MAN
items.flavor: The city knew the name before the algorithm did.

moves.name: Soundcheck
moves.desc: The room goes quiet first. Reveal the crowd.

moves.name: Hometown Anthem
moves.desc: Discard 2 Energies. Every seat in the building takes it.

items.lore:
Artist. San Antonio. Calling him a rapper undersells it, he does all of it and the credit list keeps getting longer.

First on the roster. Not a subject, a member: the desk shoots every frame of what comes next.

What he's loading stays off the page until it drops. When it drops, it drops with our footage on it.

Texas first. Then everywhere else.

items.name: VIRGOSGATEWAY
items.flavor: You've already heard him. You just didn't know it.

moves.name: Alignment
moves.desc: Universal divinity receives it. Next move does +60.

moves.name: Transmission
moves.desc: Every speaker in range obeys.

items.lore:
Rapper. San Antonio. Punk on the surface, trap in the bones, anarchy on the hook.

Second artist on the roster. Sessions are closed, and what's coming out of them is classified until it isn't.

When the file opens, the desk has the frames.

items.name: WRATHFOL

moves.name: Any Genre
moves.desc: Produces anything. Copy any move in play.

moves.name: Full Send
moves.desc: Not subtle. Everything in the room takes it.

items.lore:
Producer. San Antonio by way of Houston. Jack of all trades, produces anything, and every beat carries a story.

Energetic, fun, built for everybody in the room. Subtle was never the assignment. Heavy hitter.

Off the boards he's an adventurer. Ask where he's been, then listen to what he made when he got back.

items.name: The Ink
items.flavor: Oil on canvas after hours. Skin by appointment.

moves.name: Line Work
moves.desc: Slow is smooth. Next move can't miss.

moves.name: Black & Grey
moves.desc: No color needed. The shading does the talking.

items.lore:
Black and grey by appointment, oil on canvas after hours. The crossover is the story.

Interview 002 is out. The format moved from the chair to the bench: the machine runs while the conversation does, and the room light stays the room light. Nobody hears the questions, they sit on screen as cards.

The subject saw the cut before anyone else. House rule, and it held.

items.name: KURLYTOP
items.flavor: God-fearing and unorthodox, in that order.

moves.name: Testimony
moves.desc: Say the part everybody leaves out. The room gets quiet.

moves.name: Unorthodox
moves.desc: Does it the wrong way. It works. Nobody can explain it.

items.lore:
Joseph Hector Espino. San Antonio. Music, videos, and the long way around.

His own bio does the introduction better than we could: God-fearing man, unorthodox. That collision is the whole seat.

Seat filled 8/24. He picks his own song and his own card art, the same as everybody else here.

items.name: HAZE DT

moves.name: Digital Diary
moves.desc: Posts the entry before it is finished. That is the format.

moves.name: Four Cities
moves.desc: Plays a room, leaves, plays another one. Repeat until it lands.

items.lore:
Haze Dt Nightingale. Singer, performer, artist in every way, which is her own phrase and the reason for the seat.

Runs between New York, Houston, San Antonio and Austin. Played Saint Mary's on 8/23.

Seat filled 8/24. Song and card art are hers to set.

items.name: WUN MOR
items.flavor: Commissions open. They come back with teeth.

moves.name: Wet Ink
moves.desc: Heavy black line first, colour after. Nothing gets drawn twice.

moves.name: Gold Grill
moves.desc: Casts it, paints it, sets the teeth. It leaves meaner than it came in.

items.lore:
Wun. Draws in heavy black line on paper he stains first, and casts and paints his own figures when the paper is not enough.

The cast is gremlins, jesters and long toothed dogs, and the WUN MOR tag usually goes inside the piece instead of under it. Commissions open, and they have been for a while.

Seat filled 8/26, shot at the booth with the mask on. The song is still his to set.

items.name: SINIK
items.flavor: Outside the room before he was inside it.

moves.name: Pull Up
moves.desc: Arrives with the bottle and the whole parking lot knows.

moves.name: From Tx
moves.desc: San Antonio on the shirt, San Antonio in the record.

items.lore:
Sinik. San Antonio.

Seat filled 8/27. The song, the words on the back of this card and the art are his to set, the same as everybody else on this list.

Shot outside the room on 8/23.

items.name: VAMPPSYCH
items.flavor: In the room every week. Never in the frame.

moves.name: Clock In
moves.desc: The city goes dark and he is already set up in the corner.

moves.name: Full Quality
moves.desc: Every frame from the night, free, before anyone asks twice.

items.lore:
Gianni. FX6, Insta360, Full Sail Digital Cinematography, and a card in his own house because he shoots it every week like everybody else on this list.

Zenhouse Fridays, The Mix on the Strip, Paper Tiger, the raves, Legion Ink after hours. Directed VOLUME. Cuts gothic essays as Vamppsych.

Runs the desk, which is why this card sits at the end of the roster and not the front of it.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Page
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Draws the rooms the cameras can't enter.

moves.name: Cold Open
moves.desc: Sets the scene in one panel.

moves.name: Splash Page
moves.desc: Full bleed. No dialogue needed.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Comics, zines, ink on paper. The lane where the scene draws itself.

Seat 003 is in talks. The reveal is the drop.

Same house rules apply: the subject sees the cut first, and off the record stays off the record.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Hairstylist
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Does the color on camera. Conversation cuts deeper.

moves.name: Dye Job
moves.desc: Marks the next subject in the scene.

moves.name: First Cut
moves.desc: Sets the format. Coin flip: heads, copy the format.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
The chair is the studio. Color, cuts, whatever walks in.

This is the seat that set the house format: the work happens on camera while you talk, at your own station, never sat against a wall.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Promoter
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Holds the door. Knows who pays the rider.

moves.name: Flyer Drop
moves.desc: Posts a venue. Reveals one secret show.

moves.name: Doors at 9
moves.desc: Loads the queue. Crowd silences any Take this turn.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Holds the door. Knows who pays the rider. Books the room before the artist knows they are playing it.

The shows on the books are somebody's work and that somebody is usually invisible. This seat is for whoever that is.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The DJ
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Knows what the room needs before it does.

moves.name: Crossfade
moves.desc: Switch any lane mid-set.

moves.name: Drop the Beat
moves.desc: Discard one Take to do +30 to a Voice.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Reads the floor in two bars and adjusts. Late hours, no requests, no talking on the mic.

The crossfade is the commentary. This seat is for whoever is making that call at 3am.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Label Head

moves.name: A&R Stare
moves.desc: Marks a Pitch. Returns it next turn.

moves.name: Test Pressing
moves.desc: Discard two Energies. Hits anything in the public feed.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Final cut. Final cheque. The one who says yes or no on a test pressing.

A roster run out of a bedroom counts. Saying no more than yes counts.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Provocateur
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Off the record stays off the record. The rest is fair game.

moves.name: Subtweet
moves.desc: Reveal one Pitch from your deck. Your opponent cannot respond this turn.

moves.name: Drag
moves.desc: Choose 1 Voice in play. They cannot use their attack until two turns pass.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Speaks for nobody. Speaks for everybody.

The take nobody else will put their name on. House rule still applies: off the record stays off the record, the rest is fair game.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Painter
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Says it all without saying it.

moves.name: Underpainting
moves.desc: Sets up the next attack. Next move does +50.

moves.name: One Stroke
moves.desc: One canvas, one shot. Discard if you flip tails.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Says it all without saying it.

Oil, gesso, spray, whatever the surface is. The people the cameras do not catch get caught here instead. One a month is a pace.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Archivist
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Remembers. Even the things you deleted.

moves.name: Footnote
moves.desc: Reveals what's in the file.

moves.name: Receipt
moves.desc: Brings back any old Take from your discard pile.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Remembers. Even the things you deleted.

Flyers, screenshots, secret show photos, a hard drive of receipts. The scene's memory before the scene is old enough to have one.

Nobody has this one.

_archived_unfilled_seats.name: The Outsider
_archived_unfilled_seats.flavor: Watches from the door. Knows the room better than the regulars.

moves.name: Lurk
moves.desc: Sees the room first. Look at the top 3 cards.

moves.name: Through The Door
moves.desc: Always returns to the scene.

_archived_unfilled_seats.lore:
Watches from the door. Knows the room better than the regulars.

No clique, no networking, at every show anyway. The most reliable narrator in the building is usually the one with nothing riding on it.

Nobody has this one.
